name: modern-drupal-guidance
description: Keeps your coding agent on current Drupal 10 and 11 practices instead of legacy Drupal 7 and 8 patterns.

interface.longDescription: Modern Drupal Guidance is an agent skill and CLI that gives AI coding agents short, tested guides for current Drupal core APIs at the moment they write code: OOP hooks with #[Hook], PHP attributes, dependency injection, Single Directory Components, Recipes, cache metadata and more, so they stop writing deprecated or removed APIs from their training data.
defaultPrompt: Audit this Drupal module for deprecated APIs and legacy patterns
What is the current way to implement a hook in Drupal 11?
